data.description: Typed block payload. Plain-text fields are rendered literally, so markdown syntax written into one reaches the reader as raw characters — a heading of "**Title**" publishes with the asterisks showing. Only the fields listed as markdown are parsed. A markdown field also requires editor_mode alongside it: "rich" for prose the visual editor can handle, "source" for tables or raw HTML. Asset IDs and delivery URLs belong in the block media array, never in data. Fields by block type — heading block: literal — text. Also level (one of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6). markdown block: parsed as markdown — markdown. Also editor_mode (one of rich, source). image block: literal — caption. gallery block: literal — caption. video block: literal — title, caption. Also url (url), upload_date (Upload date (YYYY-MM-DD)). faq block: literal — title. Also source (one of page_qa, organization_qa). how_to block: literal — title, label, estimated_time, tool_items.*, supply_items.*, steps.*.name, steps.*.text. divider block: no text fields. cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). contact_cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). booking_cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label, price_line, notice. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). callout block: literal — title, body, badge, buttons.*.label. Also tone (one of neutral, info, success, warning, danger). hero block: literal — title, accent, eyebrow, subtitle, cta_label, secondary_label. Also cta_url (url), secondary_url (url). button_group block: literal — buttons.*.label. feature_grid block: literal — title, description, items.*.title, items.*.description, items.*.value, items.*.label, cta_label; parsed as markdown — items.*.body. Also source (one of manual, organization_posts, calculator, billing_plans), cta_url (url). comparison block: literal — title, description, problem_title, problem_label, problem_items.*.title, problem_items.*.description, solution_title, solution_label, solution_items.*.title, solution_items.*.description. stat_grid block: literal — title, description, label, items.*.value, items.*.title. workflow_grid block: literal — title, description, label, items.*.title, items.*.prompt, items.*.description. video_feature block: literal — title, description, video_title, items.*.title, items.*.description. Also video_url (url), upload_date (Upload date (YYYY-MM-DD)). media_text block: literal — title, body, label. Also url (url). contact_form block: no text fields. team_grid block: literal — title, description, items.*.first_name, items.*.last_name, items.*.title, items.*.bio. testimonial_grid block: literal — title, description. donation_choices block: literal — title, description, tiers.*.title, tiers.*.description. Also destination (url). page_grid block: literal — title, accent, description. Also page_ids (page ids). product_grid block: literal — title, description. Also collection_id (collection id), product_ids (product ids). location_grid block: literal — title, description. Also location_ids (location ids). social_posts block: literal — title, description, call_to_action.label. Also limit (whole number 1–12, default 6), location_id (location id), call_to_action.url (url). ai_assistance block: literal — label, intro, prompts.*.title, prompts.*.prompt, prompts.*.description, prompts.*.copy_label.

open_time.description: Local wall-clock time, HH:mm (24-hour), in the explicitly selected location timezone.

special_hours.description: Explicit dated hours or closures. Closure starts_on is required; ends_on is inclusive and null means indefinite. Dated hours replace regular hours; periods [] closes the date.

tiktok_url.description: Full TikTok profile URL for this location, e.g. https://tiktok.com/@yourhandle. Include the https:// scheme.

timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier for this location, e.g. Asia/Bangkok. Used to interpret opening hours and booking slots.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

announcement.description: The universal announcement modal shown to visitors on the public website, available to every theme. An image, when set, is a separate organization media placement (slot "announcement"), not a field here.

cta_label.description: Button label. Requires cta_url and vice versa.

cta_url.description: Button destination, http or https. Requires cta_label and vice versa.

dismissible.description: Whether a visitor who closes it will not be shown it again on that device.

enabled.description: Whether the announcement is currently shown. false keeps the saved content without showing it.

headline.description: Required in every write, even an empty string when disabling without discarding it.

canonical_url.description: Optional site-wide canonical URL override for the homepage.

contact_email.description: Public contact email shown to guests. Pass null to clear it.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

seo_description.description: Optional site-wide default SEO description override. Falls back to brand_description if unset.

seo_title.description: Optional site-wide default SEO title override for the homepage and any page without its own override. Falls back to name if unset.

status.description: Website status: active is Live (public and indexable), inactive is Draft (preview only). A suspended website cannot be changed.

body.description: The caption, plain text; newlines are kept.

anyOf.description: A button the author wrote: its label and an http(s) or tel: destination. Sent to Facebook and Instagram as a separate "label: url" line under the caption; Instagram shows it as text, not a button.

location_id.description: Scope the post to one of this organization's locations; omit for organization-wide.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

slug.description: Optional route segment for /posts/<slug>. Allocated from the title or body when omitted, and fixed once the post is published.

title.description: Optional headline. Never invented when absent.

visibility.description: listed shows the post in feeds; unlisted keeps it reachable by its URL only. Neither makes a draft public.

preview_url.description: A signed link to the draft as visitors will see it.

items.description: One external publication of this post. Private to the organization.

local_content_changed.description: The website copy changed after this was sent. The external post was not edited.

public_url.description: The provider's own permalink, when it returned one.

source.description: Who owns the words: the organization, or the provider it was imported from until someone edits it.

updated_at.description: The expected_updated_at update_post and publish_post take.

replayed.description: True when this idempotency_key had already created the post.

active.description: Enable or disable sale of this product. Independent of site and location publication.

marketing_features.description: Generic selling bullets. Inclusions, preparation instructions and policies are separate metafields.

metadata.description: Opaque string annotations for integrations. No pricing, scheduling, stock or filtering behavior may read these.

metafields.description: Complete replacement map keyed by "<namespace>.<key>"; preserve all entries you want to keep. Remove an entry to clear its value; use {} when no entries remain, never null values. For a literal price such as "Market price", set "pricing.note" to the exact user-provided text and send empty prices arrays for every variant. Numeric prices and pricing.note are mutually exclusive; clear pricing.note when adding numeric prices. Text-only prices display publicly but cannot be checked out. The definition must already exist; create it with create_metafield_definition.

order_url.description: A narrow ordering destination such as a delivery partner. Not the public product page.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

unit_label.description: A unit noun such as "person" or "night". Never pricing prose.

variants.description: Omit to create a single default variant. Required once the product has options.

items.description: One buyable configuration. A product with no options still has exactly one. Keep the id when editing: a variant that keeps its id keeps its bookings.

option_values.description: Option id to option value id. Every option must be answered exactly once, and no two variants may answer identically.

items.description: A monetary offer on this variant. unit_amount is an integer in the currency smallest unit; 0 is an explicit free offer, and a variant with no price is not purchasable rather than free. Billing recurrence describes when the customer is charged, never when a class runs.

location_id.description: Scope this offer to one location, or null for every location the product is offered at.

active.description: The merchant sale switch. Not visibility and not stock: a disabled product is not sold out.

location_id.description: The location this offer applies at, or null for a location-neutral offer. Null is a declared scope, not a missing value.

unit_amount.description: Integer amount in the currency smallest unit.

additional_notes_html.description: Guest-facing notes. Sanitized on the way in; only basic formatting and links survive.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

blocks.description: Complete canonical block array. Each existing block must retain its id unless its removal is explicitly confirmed. Block data never contains asset IDs or delivery URLs. Omit media to preserve that block's current placements; provide media explicitly to replace them, or call set_media with owner_type "content_block", the block id, and the intended slot.

data.description: Typed block payload. Plain-text fields are rendered literally, so markdown syntax written into one reaches the reader as raw characters — a heading of "**Title**" publishes with the asterisks showing. Only the fields listed as markdown are parsed. A markdown field also requires editor_mode alongside it: "rich" for prose the visual editor can handle, "source" for tables or raw HTML. Asset IDs and delivery URLs belong in the block media array, never in data. Fields by block type — heading block: literal — text. Also level (one of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6). markdown block: parsed as markdown — markdown. Also editor_mode (one of rich, source). image block: literal — caption. gallery block: literal — caption. video block: literal — title, caption. Also url (url), upload_date (Upload date (YYYY-MM-DD)). faq block: literal — title. Also source (one of page_qa, organization_qa). how_to block: literal — title, label, estimated_time, tool_items.*, supply_items.*, steps.*.name, steps.*.text. divider block: no text fields. cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). contact_cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). booking_cta block: literal — title, accent, description, label, secondary_label, price_line, notice. Also url (url), secondary_url (url). callout block: literal — title, body, badge, buttons.*.label. Also tone (one of neutral, info, success, warning, danger). hero block: literal — title, accent, eyebrow, subtitle, cta_label, secondary_label. Also cta_url (url), secondary_url (url). button_group block: literal — buttons.*.label. feature_grid block: literal — title, description, items.*.title, items.*.description, items.*.value, items.*.label, cta_label; parsed as markdown — items.*.body. Also source (one of manual, organization_posts, calculator, billing_plans), cta_url (url). comparison block: literal — title, description, problem_title, problem_label, problem_items.*.title, problem_items.*.description, solution_title, solution_label, solution_items.*.title, solution_items.*.description. stat_grid block: literal — title, description, label, items.*.value, items.*.title. workflow_grid block: literal — title, description, label, items.*.title, items.*.prompt, items.*.description. video_feature block: literal — title, description, video_title, items.*.title, items.*.description. Also video_url (url), upload_date (Upload date (YYYY-MM-DD)). media_text block: literal — title, body, label. Also url (url). contact_form block: no text fields. team_grid block: literal — title, description, items.*.first_name, items.*.last_name, items.*.title, items.*.bio. testimonial_grid block: literal — title, description. donation_choices block: literal — title, description, tiers.*.title, tiers.*.description. Also destination (url). page_grid block: literal — title, accent, description. Also page_ids (page ids). product_grid block: literal — title, description. Also collection_id (collection id), product_ids (product ids). location_grid block: literal — title, description. Also location_ids (location ids). social_posts block: literal — title, description, call_to_action.label. Also limit (whole number 1–12, default 6), location_id (location id), call_to_action.url (url). ai_assistance block: literal — label, intro, prompts.*.title, prompts.*.prompt, prompts.*.description, prompts.*.copy_label.

updated_at.description: As read. Ignored on a whole-document write.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

pageType.description: The page's type. Send the page_type from the last read unless you are changing it.

path.description: The page path to write. Send the current path unless you are moving the page; a different path moves it and creates the locale-scoped redirect.

recipe.description: The template section this page fills, or null for a page that fills none. Send the recipe from the last read unless you are changing it; an omitted recipe is not kept.

sortOrder.description: The page's position in the site's page list. Send the sort_order from the last read unless you are reordering.

title.description: The page title to write. Always sent in full — an omitted title is not kept.

category.description: Optional visual subject used to organize the media library. It never assigns the asset to content.

description.description: Description of the media (stored as alt text).

file.description: Authorized file reference supplied by ChatGPT after rewriting the declared top-level file argument, including a temporary download_url and file_id.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

poster_file.description: Required poster/thumbnail image for video uploads. Invalid for non-video uploads.
